text:
sarah: Quick follow-up from yesterday's auth outage — want to lock down owners/timelines for the fixes we agreed. Short thread so we can triage.
omar: Thanks. I'll own the immediate token cleanup and rotation plan. Will need list of affected service-accounts.
maria: I'll do the audit-log sampling job and add retention alert. ETA end of next week.
tim: I'll add a realtime perms-drift detector to eng-sre alerting (low-priority first).
kevin: I can run an inventory scan across k8s + cloud IAM and output CSV. When do you want that?
sarah: Great. Kevin/omar: aim for 3 business days for inventory. maria: +1 week for sampling job. tim: 2 weeks for detector POC. I'll summarize AIs below.
sarah: A1 — rotate stale svc tokens, owner: omar, due: 2026-03-30, note: `rotate-service-tokens --dry-run` then full rotate.
omar: Started list generation now. Using `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list` + `jq` to filter lastUsed > 90d.
kevin: I'll hand CSV to omar once inventory finishes. Running scan today.
remediation-bot: Task created: SEC-2345 Rotate stale tokens (assignee: omar, due: 2026-03-30) :white_check_mark: 
maria: A2 — audit-sample job, owner: maria, due: 2026-04-06. Will sample 1% of write events and surface missing audit fields.
tim: A3 — perms-drift alert, owner: tim, due: 2026-04-13. Will hook alert to #eng-oncall + pager policy. @omar can you provide sample RBAC change logs?
sarah: A4 — service-account inventory, owner: kevin, due: 2026-03-26. Deliverable: CSV + quick chart of top 20 accounts by activity.
kevin: Putting results in `/shared/sec/inventory/2026-03-24-inventory.csv` when done. ping me if you need diff output.
sarah: A5 — secrets rotation cadence doc, owner: sarah, due: 2026-04-02. We'll propose weekly rotation for low-risk keys, monthly for infra keys.
tim: Noted — I'll add an automated check that flags keys not rotated in X days.
maria: Also found recurring pattern: two incidents in last 9 weeks where stale keys + missing audit fields combined. Need to treat as a recurring incident pattern.
sarah: Agree. We'll run a 4-week follow-up check after these AIs land. If pattern persists, escalate to exec.
omar: Quick question: do we want to bulk-revoke tokens or rotate service accounts? Bulk revoke might break consumers.
sarah: Start with targeted rotation for tokens that show no lastUsed for >90d. We'll stage with canary namespaces.
kevin: Canary plan: rotate in dev -> staging -> prod over 24h windows. I'll document the steps.
remediation-bot: Reminder scheduled: SEC-2345 review in 7 days.
tim: I'll add the perms detector to my sprint and put the PR link here when ready.
kevin: :thumbsup: 
maria: If anyone needs the query I used: `SELECT service_account, last_used FROM iam_keys WHERE last_used < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY)`
sarah: Thanks all. I'll compile AIs into the incident tracker and assign follow-ups. Short daily sync stand-up at 10am tomorrow topic: creds QA loop.
omar: See you 10am. I'll bring the initial list.
